Name: Erwin Smith - NPC - Attack on Titan
Author: LittlePippi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FEGMurt.png[/img]
﻿After losing his right arm and nearly his life, Erwin Smith decided to settle in Pelican Town to run the Adventurer’s Guild. He might have lost his Commander role, but not the mindset. There’s always an enemy and it’s now Erwin’s mission to keep the town safe from evil.

Though composed and polite, Erwin carries the quiet weight of a man who sacrificed everything for a cause that no longer exists. He’s thoughtful, intelligent, and endlessly curious, some would say with a bad sense of humour. He’s a man burdened by past decisions and often slipping into his old Commander persona. As your bond with him deepens, you'll uncover the quieter layers beneath his stoic exterior.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/FW3aYZ5.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6WBQFED.png[/img]
﻿This mod contains mentions of war and heavy topics such as betrayal, and includes NSFW/spicy content in the darting/marriage dialogue.

No prior knowledge of Attack on Titan is required. This mod is fully adapted to the Stardew Valley universe - no Titans, no supernatural elements beyond the established in-game magic and creatures. Erwin is leader of the Adventurer’s Guild and fights the monsters in the mines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/leQh82d.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Frequently Asked Questions:[/b][/size]
[size=2][b]Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b]
A: Yes, just make sure your game is closed when you do. The only strange thing that will happen is that some NPCs and Levi will act as if he has been there for a while. 
[b]
Q: I want to play the update, can I do it mid-save?[/b]
A: Yes. Save and close your game. Download the update, replace it with the old one. 
[b]
Q: I would like to translate the mod into -said language-, can I do that?[/b]
A: Send me a message first. If you have never translated a mod before, I will also gladly help and guide you. :)

[b]Q: How does it work if I have both Levi and Erwin installed story wise?[/b]
A: If you have both Levi and Erwin installed, they will have special dialogue that acknowledges each other. They will appear in certain events with each other, Levi takes Marlon's spot etc. Levi's four heart event will be changed: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]will not speak of Erwin's death, but of the promise to Erwin to kill an enemy that he couldn't keep.[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]The mods are made to function as standalone and together. 

[b]Q: Why is Erwin standing in his underwear and sleeping in the kitchen? Why did Erwin give birth and not my farmer?[/b]
A: You are using the mod PolyamoreSweet. Please refer those bugs to the creator of the mod.[/size]
